import numpy as np
knots=np.linspace(0.5,8,25)
def hat(tt):
    H=np.zeros((len(tt),len(knots)))
    for j in range(len(knots)):
        if j>0:
            m=(tt>=knots[j-1])&(tt<=knots[j]); H[m,j]=(tt[m]-knots[j-1])/(knots[j]-knots[j-1])
        if j<len(knots)-1:
            m=(tt>=knots[j])&(tt<=knots[j+1]); H[m,j]=np.maximum(H[m,j],(knots[j+1]-tt[m])/(knots[j+1]-knots[j]))
    return H
